verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a speech-to-text API service, not an agent or assistant that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The only MCP evidence, "Install MCP server on Cursor" [rev-ai-docs-23], describes Rev AI serving an MCP server to Cursor (the server role). It does not show Rev AI consuming other MCP servers' tools, so the client axis does not apply.
